exclusions.degree_walls: Kill roles that require a completed degree unless the posting's own words accept equivalent experience.
exclusions.experience_walls: Kill roles requiring 4+ years in a specialty I do not have.

distance_bands_miles.over_30: only if pay is exceptional for the tier

protected_schedule.rule: Class blocks are walls. Nothing is scheduled over them and any role whose schedule can rotate into them is flagged before I accept.

references.policy: Exactly one named reference (a former store manager). Applications requiring 2 or more named references up front are a hard stop. 'References available on request' is fine.

writing_rules: Nothing is submitted, sent, or posted without my approval of the exact text.
Follow-ups add something new each time: a detail, a new angle, a graceful close.
Plain, direct, friendly. No corporate filler.
